meaning:
Ἡρῳδιάς (Rec. Ἡρω-), -άδος, ἡ
Herodias, granddaughter of Herod the Great: Mat.14:3, 6, Mrk.6:17, 19 6:22, Luk.3:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For Herod had arrested John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.
For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,
